_readme: Stable Mainnet (988) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/stable.json ./scripts/seed.sh stable [--broadcast]. IMPORTANT: Stable's canonical wrapped-native is WgUSDT (0x817997ca8394e26cce3de3a076a4889b27dbf9de, 18-dec — interface wrappedNativeCurrency=WgUSDT; the DEX is deployed against it, replacing the earlier throwaway own-WETH9 stack). Native gas is USDT0 (18-dec native), which is NOT WgUSDT, so the seeder's auto-wrap of native does NOT apply. So this config uses a MINT/MINT pool (two fresh test tokens), which needs no wrapped-native. ~1.13 gwei; chains.json sets gasPriceGwei=2. Set STABLE_RPC_URL in ../.env (or the public https://rpc.stable.xyz default). priceAperB / amounts are DEMO-scale — replace with real seed amounts + the real USDT0 ERC-20 (0x779Ded0c9e1022225f8E0630b35a9b54bE713736, 6-dec) paired pools for production depth. To later seed a WgUSDT-paired pool, first acquire/hold WgUSDT (0x817997ca..f9de) and add a WETH-kind pool against it.

988.label: tHOOK / USDT0 v2 (Stable — MINT/MINT demo, no native wrap)
